title: Rhetorical InDEX benchmark annotation document
description: One annotated article. Only documents with adjudicationStatus='adjudicated' are scored, AND only after passing benchmarks/scripts/validate_corpus.py — an adjudicated file that fails validation is a FATAL corpus-integrity error, never a silent skip. Files whose name begins with '_' are never loaded. SCHEMA/VALIDATOR BOUNDARY (stated honestly, not claimed as full parity): this schema expresses the STRUCTURAL contract — required fields, types, enums, and decision-specific proposalIds/resultingAnnotationIds cardinality. The following SEMANTIC checks are enforced only by validate_corpus.py, because JSON Schema cannot express cross-reference or content-dependent rules: every proposalId/resultingAnnotationId resolving to a real record; submissionId/proposalId/annotationId uniqueness across the document; annotatorIds agreeing with the annotators who actually submitted; excerpt round-tripping against passages[].text; taxonomyVersion matching the active taxonomy; mechanismId membership in the taxonomy and exclusion of cross-document mechanisms; 'merge' drawing on >= 2 DISTINCT annotators; the two-annotator auto-merge consensus rule (mechanism/passage/pressure/voice agreement, span IoU >= 0.8, gold span == intersection); and every gold annotation being grounded exactly once. A document that satisfies this schema is therefore NOT necessarily a valid corpus document.

then.description: B-05: the JSON Schema must agree with benchmarks/scripts/validate_corpus.py — an adjudicated document is not schema-valid without a preserved submission record from at least two annotators.

sourceNote.description: Provenance and rights note for the excerpt.

annotatorIds.description: Adjudicated documents require at least two distinct independent annotators. Every id must correspond to exactly one annotatorSubmissions record (enforced in benchmarks/scripts/validate_corpus.py).

annotations.description: Adjudicated GOLD spans, stored separately from annotatorSubmissions. An empty array is meaningful: it asserts this article contains no instances of the implemented mechanisms.

isHardNegativeFor.description: Mechanisms a naive detector is expected to wrongly fire here.

disagreements.description: Retained after adjudication. Erasing disagreement destroys the calibration signal.

annotatorSubmissions.description: M-12 / A-02: one RECORD per annotator, each carrying that annotator's ORIGINAL independent proposals, preserved verbatim and never overwritten by adjudication. Required for adjudicated documents so inter-annotator agreement (presence, mechanism, span, pressure, voice) stays computable after the fact. The record itself — not a non-empty proposals array — is what proves an annotator reviewed the article: `proposals: []` is a valid, meaningful record of a genuine hard negative (the annotator independently found zero rhetorical mechanisms). A document with fewer than two preserved records is invalid regardless of how many proposals it contains.

annotatorId.description: Must correspond to an entry in the document's annotatorIds.

proposals.description: This annotator's original proposed findings. MAY be empty — an empty array asserts this annotator reviewed the article and independently found nothing, which is a valid and meaningful hard-negative result, distinct from the record being absent entirely.

proposalId.description: Unique across every submission in the document.

resolutions.description: B-04 / C-03: adjudicator decisions linking original proposals to the final gold annotations, or explicitly recording an adjudicator-added finding that no proposal produced. Append-only; originals are never deleted. Every gold annotation must either be a genuine two-annotator auto-merge (ADJUDICATION.md §2) or be named by exactly one resolution's resultingAnnotationIds — see ADJUDICATION.md §7b.

resolutionId.description: Unique across the document, if used.

proposalIds.description: Every id must reference a real preserved proposal. Cardinality is decision-specific — see the allOf blocks below.

resultingAnnotationIds.description: C-03: an array, because a 'split' produces MORE THAN ONE gold annotation and the previous singular resultingAnnotationId could not represent that. Cardinality is decision-specific.

adjudicatorId.description: Required and non-empty — a resolution is by definition an adjudicator's decision.

rationale.description: Alternative to note; required (as either) for decision=adjudicator_add.
